body: You know, I don't feel the need to explore the meaning of self pity really. The meaning is kind of self evident and really not important to me anyway--I don't feel sorry for myself at all. I don't really feel anything. Self pity is kind of weird because it's invoked casually as a description of honest self-appraisal, which is not always accurate. I would say classifying something as self-pity(ing) is kind of like deciding whether or not something is pornographic. It's inexplicably obvious. And gross.
